input.quote: 8.2 Each Order Form has the initial term stated in it and thereafter renews for successive twelve-month periods unless Customer gives Vendor at least thirty days' written notice of non-renewal. Vendor shall remind Customer of an upcoming renewal at least sixty days beforehand.
input.rationale: The renewal mechanic meets our preferred position in full: renewals are successive twelve-month (not multi-year) terms, Customer may opt out on only thirty days' written notice, and Vendor must send a renewal reminder sixty days beforehand — with the opt-out deadline extended if the reminder is missed, which is better than preferred. § 8.3 caps renewal uplift at the lesser of CPI and three percent with ninety days' notice and no increase on prepaid periods, matching the preferred cap. No redline needed.
